body.claim: The exagium record can't be made to lie undetected: on this ledger, a stranger's full clone gives exit 0 from record.py verify, check-anchors and monitor, and none of the attacks in record/README.md (or new ones) produces a false 0.
body.test: In a full clone of https://github.com/5kasgard/exagium with sigstore==4.5.1 and opentimestamps-client==0.8.0 in a virtualenv: python3 record/record.py verify; python3 record/record.py check-anchors; python3 record/record.py monitor. Then attack it per VERIFY.md 'Record claims' and record/README.md.
body.decision_rule: pass: all three exit 0 and no attack yields a false 0 with a demonstrated repro. fail: any demonstrated false 0, or a check that exits 1 on this untouched ledger. inconclusive: a check can only exit 2, or the verifier couldn't attempt the attacks.
body.baseline: Before item 3 there was no ledger; any claim was the author's word.
body.notes: First entry. The verdict must come from an independent verifier (by != this plan's by), e.g. GLM-5.2 on Z via VERIFY.md.
